title: "Feature: Student Profile Management"

## Problem
No student profile or personal details are stored.

## Solution
- Add student profile page (name, contact, photo, parent info)
- Allow students to view/edit their profile
- Admin/counsellor can view student profiles

## Acceptance Criteria
- Students can update/view their profile
- Admin/counsellor can view all student profiles
